name: atelier
description: Tune a visual effect or animation with sliders, colour, easing and spring controls, then hand the values back to the agent. The agent writes a small spec; prebuilt pages render the controls, isolated or injected into your running dev server.

interface.shortDescription: Fine-tune visual effects and animations with live controls.
interface.longDescription: The agent writes a small JSON spec of tunable values; atelier renders sliders, colour, easing and spring controls beside the effect, or injects them into your running dev server page. Press Apply and the agent receives only the final values.
defaultPrompt: Let me tune this card's glow with sliders.
Give me controls for the modal's open animation.
Inject a tuning panel into localhost:5173 for the hero button.
